title: The Cold Moon in Cancer: What It Asks of Your Element

segments.text: This Christmas week, the Cold Moon rises in Cancer, the Moon's own home.
It's called the Cold Moon, because it shines on the longest nights of the year.
In winter, the full moon rides so high, it stays with you almost all night.

segments.title: FIRE SIGNS
segments.text: Fire signs, let your heart rest. You don't have to prove anything.

segments.title: EARTH SIGNS
segments.text: Earth signs, home is calling. Go back to the people who feel safe.

segments.title: AIR SIGNS
segments.text: Air signs, say the soft thing you've been holding back.

segments.title: WATER SIGNS
segments.text: Water signs, this is your moon. Cry, release, begin again.
Which element are you? Comment below, and save this for the full moon.
